claims.claim: Sanmina's ZT acquisition strengthens the causal chain from hyperscaler compute demand -> complex server/data-center manufacturing and integration -> deployable AI infrastructure capacity; vertical integration can reduce coordination friction, but hyperscaler capex and component availability remain upstream constraints.

factors.name: bottleneckControl
factors.basis: Full-system manufacturing/integration capacity participates directly in the physical deployment bottleneck for AI infrastructure.

factors.name: scenarioRobustness
factors.basis: Diversified manufacturing capabilities help, but the acquired AI/cloud exposure increases sensitivity to hyperscaler capex cycles.

factors.name: substitutionResilience
factors.basis: Scale, quality systems and integration capability create execution barriers, while large customers can dual-source and other EMS/ODM providers remain substitutes.

causalEdges.mechanism: physical systems are required to deploy compute capacity
assembly, test and system integration convert components into deployable systems

risks.risk: Manufacturing is important but not irreplaceable; customer sourcing strategy and capex timing can shift utilization quickly.

unknowns.unknown: Long-run combined-business customer concentration and normalized margin profile remain to be established by underwriting.

claims.claim: Q3 outperformance and raised guidance strengthen execution evidence, but the ZT acquisition also increases concentration, integration and working-capital sensitivity; positive operating cash flow alongside only $24M Q3 free cash flow shows that growth can remain capital intensive.

factors.name: concentration
factors.basis: Greater cloud/AI infrastructure exposure increases dependence on a smaller set of large-capex customers and programs.

factors.name: integration
factors.basis: Acquisition synergies and capacity expansion must convert without disrupting margins or working capital.

factors.name: confidence inflation
factors.basis: Raised guidance is constructive but should not be treated as proof of cycle-proof demand or normalized post-acquisition margins.

risks.risk: Hyperscaler capex, tariffs/trade policy, customer concentration and acquisition integration can amplify downside if AI infrastructure demand slows.

unknowns.unknown: Fiscal Q4 outcome and normalized ZT margin/cash-conversion profile were not yet available in the cited evidence window.
